changelog.zh:
- 修复：外挂播放器打开空窗口/一直卡住——拉起播放器前先预检上游（6s），不可达时回退内置播放并提示
- 修复：代理对「上游接了连接却不回响应头」会无限等待，现在 8s 中止并返回 504
- 修复：流式转发增加 20s 无数据看门狗，主动断开让播放器重连
- 优化：代理入口 URL 带真实扩展名（.m3u8/.ts/.mp4/.flv/.mkv），提升播放器兼容性
- 优化：HLS 子资源改为 /s/<base64>.<ext>，密钥用 .key、init 段用 .mp4
- 新增：代理请求记录（requestCount / recentRequests），便于排障
changelog.en:
- Fix: external player opened a blank window / hung — the app now pre-checks the upstream (6s) and falls back to built-in playback with a hint
- Fix: proxy no longer waits forever when the upstream accepts the connection but never sends headers (aborts after 8s, returns 504)
- Fix: 20s no-data watchdog closes the relay so the player can reconnect
- Improvement: proxy entry URLs carry a real extension (.m3u8/.ts/.mp4/.flv/.mkv)
- Improvement: HLS child resources became /s/<base64>.<ext>, keys use .key and init segments use .mp4
- New: proxy request ring buffer (requestCount / recentRequests) for troubleshooting
